data_releases_status_published_ck.name: data_releases_status_published_ck
data_releases_status_published_ck.value: ("data_releases"."status" = 'candidate' AND "data_releases"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("data_releases"."status" IN ('published', 'retired') AND "data_releases"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

geography_versions_kind_fields_ck.name: geography_versions_kind_fields_ck
geography_versions_kind_fields_ck.value: ("geography_versions"."kind" = 'house_district' AND "geography_versions"."district_plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "geography_versions"."district_code" ~ '^(AL|[0-9]{2})$') OR ("geography_versions"."kind" = 'state' AND "geography_versions"."district_plan_id" IS NULL AND "geography_versions"."district_code" IS NULL)

offices_kind_compatibility_ck.name: offices_kind_compatibility_ck
offices_kind_compatibility_ck.value: ("offices"."chamber" = 'senate' AND "offices"."kind" = 'senate' AND "offices"."district_code" IS NULL AND "offices"."senate_class" BETWEEN 1 AND 3) OR ("offices"."chamber" = 'house' AND "offices"."kind" IN ('house_voting', 'house_delegate', 'resident_commissioner') AND "offices"."district_code" ~ '^(AL|[0-9]{2})$' AND "offices"."senate_class" IS NULL)
